And here he hangs his full drink off of it so that he can answer his phone. Now, the paper never actually says how much weight it can hold, but it itself weighs about 5 oz or like the weight of a baseball on your wrist. But I also think it's kind of awesome that somebody built this because, you know, why not? They say it's the first step towards putting robots in everything we wear.
